_note: Research screen, not a trade signal. Turn any feature on or off with true / false.

retail_sources._note: Where the crowd numbers come from, tried in this order. Turn a source off with false.

_rate_note: interest_rate_forecast: score each currency's policy rate against the central bank forecast (EdgeFinder rule). Off = score the rate decision against its consensus. interest_rate_forecast_column 1 = the first quarter shown (end of this quarter).
_two_year_note: two_year_yield_7day: score the US 2-year yield like EdgeFinder (latest yield against its 7-day average; the USD Index uses it too). Off = the old rule (21-day average now against 5 days ago). two_year_avg_days sets the 7.
_carry_note: carry_policy_rates: carry and real yields use each central bank's policy rate from the Trading Economics forecast page. Off, or if the page has no number, = the FRED series.

self_heal_schedule._note: Self-healing schedule. watchdog true = a small job checks a few times an hour and starts the hourly update if no run started in the last update_overdue_minutes. false = only GitHub's own cron.
